paper_title: 3D Kidneys and Kidney Tumor Semantic Segmentation
core_problem: Tedious, error-prone, and expert-dependent manual delineation of kidneys and kidney tumors in 3D CT scans for monitoring disease progression and treatment planning.
methodology_summary: An end-to-end boundary aware fully Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with an encoder-decoder architecture, featuring a dedicated boundary branch supervised by edge-aware loss terms.
datasets_eval: 2019 MICCAI KiTS Kidney Tumor Segmentation Challenge dataset
empirical_results: Dice scores of 0.9742 for kidney and 0.8103 for tumor, with an overall composite dice score of 0.8923.
